item.title: Store administration
item.description:
Identity

tik actor add alice ~/.config/tik/id_ed25519.pub
tik sign 3184
tik witness 3184

actor add registers a signer in the store’s allowed-signers registry. Exporting TIK_KEY signs every write as it happens; sign catches up on your own earlier events, and only your own — signing somebody else’s would assert something false. witness countersigns a ticket’s head, and one signature timestamps the entire ancestry beneath it.

Roles

tik roles
tik roles add triager alice
tik roles remove triager bob

A process definition declares which roles exist and who starts in them; the store’s register decides who is in one today, for every ticket at once. Use it for a hire or a departure — it takes effect on in-flight tickets immediately, with no definition version bump and no per-ticket migration. See Roles and authority .
